tools.name: get_sdn_list_meta
tools.description: Return the provenance AND the freshness of the loaded OFAC SDN list: source URL, publish date, record count, fetch time, the source + index content hashes, and how many days old the snapshot is against a 14-day staleness threshold (the flag keys on fetch age, not publish age). No input, no PII. Use

tools.name: screen_sdn
tools.description: Screen a name against a dated snapshot of the public OFAC SDN list. Returns one of three verdicts — match, possible_match, or no_match — and ranked matches with the OFAC list entry and the field that matched. The query is NOT stored or anchored on this path. A potential match requires human review —

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sdn_list_meta, screen_sdn · Private data: get_sdn_list_meta · Public sink: get_sdn_list_meta.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sdn_list_meta, screen_sdn · Private data: get_sdn_list_meta · Public sink: get_sdn_list_meta

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
